newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs dollar, NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs dollar, NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed steady against the central bank basket on Tuesday and practically unchanged against the dollar in routine trading, dealers said.

The forint remained at the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid) throughout the day and finished at 183.48/52 against the dollar, compared with 183.52/56 at opening and 183.55/60 at midday.
Dealers said the forint followed the dollar/mark during the day.
